assertions.summary: HAProxy returned HTTP 200 with the exact required body.

evidence.command:
set +e
for target in http://127.0.0.1/ http://127.0.0.1:3000/; do
  printf '%s\n' "=== $target ==="
  curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 --write-out '\n__HTTP_STATUS__=%{http_code}\n' "$target"
  printf 'curl_exit=%s\n' "$?"
done
evidence.observation: For http://127.0.0.1/, the body was infraset-nodejs, status was 200, and curl_exit was 0.

assertions.summary: Runtime ownership and valid HAProxy configuration prove forwarding to the loopback Node.js backend.

evidence.command:
set +e
printf '%s\n' '=== service units ==='
systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'haproxy|node|app|web' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== active matching units ==='
systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-legend 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'haproxy|node|app|web' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== listeners ==='
sudo ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E '(:80[[:space:]]|:3000[[:space:]])' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== processes ==='
ps -eo user,pid,ppid,comm,args 2>/dev/null | grep -E '[h]aproxy|[n]ode' || true
evidence.observation: haproxy owned *:80; nodejs owned 127.0.0.1:3000. Both matching services were active and running.

evidence.command:
set +e
printf '%s\n' '=== haproxy routing directives ==='
sudo grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*(frontend|backend|bind|default_backend|server)[[:space:]]' /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '=== haproxy config validation ==='
sudo haproxy -c -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
printf '%s\n' '=== haproxy unit state ==='
systemctl show haproxy.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p UnitFileState -p FragmentPath -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>/dev/null
evidence.observation: The configuration binds *:80, selects backend infraset_nodejs, and declares server nodejs_local at 127.0.0.1:3000. HAProxy reported Configuration file is valid and was active, running, and enabled.

assertions.summary: Services and durable files are enabled and present, but the authored network-policy requirement is not fully established because UFW reports inactive.

evidence.command:
set +e
printf '%s\n' '=== enabled startup units ==='
for unit in haproxy.service infraset-nodejs.service nodejs.service; do
  printf '%s: ' "$unit"
  systemctl is-enabled "$unit" 2>&1
  systemctl show "$unit" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p FragmentPath -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>/dev/null
 done
printf '%s\n' '=== durable configuration files ==='
sudo stat -c '%n type=%F size=%s mode=%a owner=%U:%G' /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js 2>&1
sudo grep -nE 'listen|3000|infraset-nodejs|127\.0\.0\.1|localhost' /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: haproxy.service and infraset-nodejs.service were enabled and active/running. The HAProxy config and Node.js server file were root-owned regular files; server.js contains server.listen(3000, '127.0.0.1').

evidence.command:
set +e
printf '%s\n' '=== UFW policy ==='
sudo ufw status verbose 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '=== security/control service state ==='
for unit in ufw.service apparmor.service snapd.apparmor.service; do
  printf '%s enabled: ' "$unit"
  systemctl is-enabled "$unit" 2>&1
  printf '%s active: ' "$unit"
  systemctl is-active "$unit" 2>&1
done
printf '%s\n' '=== AppArmor kernel/profile state ==='
if [ -r /sys/module/apparmor/parameters/enabled ]; then
  printf 'kernel_enabled='
  tr -d '\n' < /sys/module/apparmor/parameters/enabled
  printf '\n'
fi
sudo aa-status 2>&1
evidence.observation: UFW reported Status: inactive, although ufw.service was enabled and active. AppArmor was enabled and active, the kernel module was enabled, and 13 profiles were loaded in enforce mode.

limitations: UFW inactivity leaves a durable active network policy for the web service unproven; no transient dependency was established.

assertions.summary: The required Ubuntu release and running web stack were present, but evaluator-named temporary residue remained in /tmp.

evidence.command:
set +e
printf '%s\n' '=== release ==='
. /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null
printf 'PRETTY_NAME=%s\nVERSION_ID=%s\n' "$PRETTY_NAME" "$VERSION_ID"
printf '%s\n' '=== failed units ==='
systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '=== web-related units ==='
systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'haproxy|node|nginx|apache|httpd|lighttpd|caddy|python.*http|web' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== web/debug processes ==='
ps -eo user,pid,ppid,comm,args 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '[h]aproxy|[n]ode|[n]ginx|[a]pache2|[h]ttpd|[l]ighttpd|[c]addy|[p]ython.*http\.server|[d]ebug|[s]trace|[g]db' || true
printf '%s\n' '=== listeners ==='
sudo ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null
evidence.observation: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS was reported; no failed units were listed; only the expected HAProxy and InfraSet Node.js web services were active. HAProxy and Node.js were the relevant web listeners.

evidence.command:
set +e
printf '%s\n' '=== package audit ==='
sudo dpkg --audit 2>&1
printf 'dpkg_audit_exit=%s\n' "$?"
sudo apt-get -s check 2>&1
printf 'apt_check_exit=%s\n' "$?"
printf '%s\n' '=== web-stack temporary/backup residue ==='
sudo find /etc/haproxy /etc/systemd/system /opt/infraset-nodejs -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.bak' -o -name '*.backup' -o -name '*.old' -o -name '*~' -o -name '*.tmp' -o -name '*.swp' \) -print 2>&1
find /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type f \( -iname '*haproxy*' -o -iname '*nodejs*' -o -iname '*infraset*' -o -name '*.bak' -o -name '*.backup' -o -name '*.old' -o -name '*~' -o -name '*.tmp' -o -name '*.swp' \) -print 2>&1
evidence.observation: Package audit and simulated apt check succeeded, but /tmp contained ten infraset-named artifacts, including proxy/backend captures, package-install logs/PID, a HAProxy fragment, final-loop/final-lan bodies, and infraset-unexpected.

failures: Concrete temporary web-stack residue remained under /tmp, so the clean-state assertion's fail condition was met.

overall_summary: The HTTP contract and HAProxy-to-Node.js forwarding passed. Startup durability is indeterminate because UFW was inactive, and operational cleanliness failed due to remaining infraset-named temporary artifacts.
